title: Higgsfield Katana in Claude
author: visionaryclown.tv
key_info: Higgsfield MCP + Katana skill is real and works inside Claude, but it needs a paid Higgsfield plan (not free) and is a reference-video editing skill; the one-prompt motion-graphics demo is unproven.

title: AI YouTube channel automation
author: aiwithsanskar
key_info: Real free building blocks (Edge TTS, Pexels API, Gemini free tier) but the specific repo is unverified and the autopilot-income claim is misleading; YouTube demonetizes mass-produced AI channels.

title: FreeVideo for local AI video
author: umarmullaai
key_info: FreeVideo is a real, Apache-2.0 ComfyUI engine that runs a modified MiniMax H3 (VDN-H3) video model locally on 8 GB VRAM, but 8 GB is the minimum, it will be slow, and the model weights carry a restrictive community licence.
